instruction_summary: Recover the final deliverables for the persona-vectors 2026 model-refresh living-update (study 004): the compute run finished the Qwen3.5-9B generations and judged the steering grid but died on --timeout before the result card. Add Qwen3.5-9B (era 6, release 2026-03, n_layers 32, kind new) to the 5-model ladder using ONLY CPU + OpenRouter-API post-processing (no GPU, no model loading, no re-generation): parse C5/C8/C1 from results/progress.txt, re-judge the monitor CSVs for C2 with the same paper-exact gpt-4.1-mini judge, re-aggregate, extend the over-time figure, and write result_card.json / report.md / followup_summary.json.

steps.description: Studied the 004 run dir, the 5-model aggregate.json schema, the pipeline scripts (judge_extract.py, rejudge_all.py, compute_results.py, make_figures.py, pick_layers.py), and the 002 deliverable templates.

Discovered Qwen3.5-9B stage-1 was already judged (rejudged/Qwen3.5-9B baseline + coarse sidecars, sel_layer.json = {evil:18, sycophantic:21, hallucinating:18}) and that the job died mid MONITOR generation (6_s2.log ends at 'MONITOR hallucinating pos') BEFORE monitor_proj and step8. Verified the monitor CSVs have NO projection column and no cached activations, and there is no step8/monitor_proj for Qwen3.5-9B.
steps.command: ls results/{rejudged,logs,monitor_proj,step8}/Qwen3.5-9B; head monitor CSV columns; tail logs/Qwen3.5-9B/6_s2.log

steps.description: Hit an environmental WRITE BLOCKER: the entire /net/projects2 export was read-only (EROFS on every write incl. paths not owned by the user; mount showed rw). Confirmed /net/scratch is writable and set up a staging mirror of the RUN layout there.

Re-judged the 4 unjudged monitor CSVs (evil/sycophantic pos+neg, 500 rows each) with the paper-exact gpt-4.1-mini instrument via rejudge_all.py (same judge as all other models; writes the gpt_<trait> sidecar format compute_results.py reads). 0 judge errors, ~$0.95.
outputs: monitor means: sycophantic pos 98.80 / neg 4.01; evil pos 10.96 / neg 0.00

steps.description: Built the Qwen3.5-9B aggregate entry (era 6, 2026-03, 32L, new) from the on-disk paper-judge sidecars: C5 baseline, C8 selected layer, C1 curve+effect at the selected layer (coarse coefs 1.0/1.5/2.0 == progress.txt). Set C2 to null (projection column absent; monitor_proj GPU step never ran) and C13 to null (step8 never ran), each with a clear descope note. Appended to a copy of 002's 5-model aggregate; wrote the 6-model aggregate.json.
Regenerated the tidy long-format table for all 6 models from the extended aggregate.
Regenerated the over-time arc (fig1) and steering dose-response (fig2) figures to include the 2026 Qwen3.5-9B point; Panels B/C annotate the 2026 column as 'not measured this tick (GPU step)'.

Wrote the three deliverables (result_card.json schema sai.followup.result_card/v1, report.md, followup_summary.json) into the staging mirror, plus a copy_back.sh rsync helper to land everything under RUN once /net/projects2 is writable again.

comparison_to_original.note: Steering replicates on the 2026 model; sycophantic/hallucinating near ceiling, evil ~71.
Low, well-behaved baselines; lowest baseline hallucination on the ladder.
Projection column (GPU monitor_proj) never computed before timeout; monitors re-judged, r left null. Behavioral pos/neg separation strong (syco 98.8 vs 4.0).
Five prior models reused verbatim; only Qwen3.5-9B computed this session.

deviations: WRITE BLOCKER (environmental): the entire /net/projects2 export was read-only (EROFS) for the whole tick, so the RUN tree could not be written. All deliverables were produced in a writable staging mirror at /net/scratch/haokunliu/pv004-recovery/ (never under /home), with copy_back.sh to land them under RUN once the filesystem is writable. This is an environmental limit, not a task failure; every number is computed and staged.

C2 descope is upstream of judging: the monitor generations were re-judged with the paper-exact instrument, but the projection column that compute_results.py correlates against is a GPU monitor_proj artifact that never ran (job died mid monitor-generation). The persona vectors (*.pt) exist but per-sample monitor activations do not, so projections cannot be recomputed on CPU. C2 set to null with the trait side cached for a GPU follow-up; hallucinating additionally has no monitor file.
C13 (step8 separability) descoped: never ran, needs GPU; set to null with a note.

C1 curve for Qwen3.5-9B uses the 3 coarse coefs (1.0/1.5/2.0) judged into progress.txt (per instruction), not the 5-point confirm curve; the raw confirm sweep (0.5-2.5) exists unjudged on disk and was not re-judged this tick.

Used the paper's own rejudge_all.py (identical gpt-4.1-mini instrument and params as judge_extract.py) to re-judge the monitors, because it emits the exact gpt_<trait> sidecar format compute_results.py reads for every other model and handles the *_monitor_*.csv naming (judge_extract.py targets *_instruct.csv and writes in-place). The judging instrument was not swapped.
